jina: The Government of the United Republic and its authority
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Government of the United Republic which shall have authority over all Union Matters in the United Republic and over all other matters concerning Mainland Tanzania. (2) The authority of the Government of the United Republic shall relate to the implementation and preservation of this Constitution and to all other matters over which Parliament has power to legislate. (3) All the authority of the Government of the United Republic over all Union Matters in the United Republic and over all other matters concerning Mainland Tanzania shall vest in the President of the United Republic. (4) Subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, the authority of the Government of the United Republic shall be exercised either by the President himself or by delegation of such authority to other persons holding office in the service of the Government of the United Republic. (5) It is hereby declared that the provisions of this Article shall not be construed as - (a) transferring to the President any powers vested by law in any person or authority other than the President; or (b) preventing Parliament from vesting any powers in any person or authority other than the President.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a Government of the United Republic which shall have authority over all Union Matters in the United Republic and over all other matters concerning Mainland Tanzania.

(2) The authority of the Government of the United Republic shall relate to the implementation and preservation of this Constitution and to all other matters over which Parliament has power to legislate.

(3) All the authority of the Government of the United Republic over all Union Matters in the United Republic and over all other matters concerning Mainland Tanzania shall vest in the President of the United Republic.

(4) Subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, the authority of the Government of the United Republic shall be exercised either by the President himself or by delegation of such authority to other persons holding office in the service of the Government of the United Republic.

(5) It is hereby declared that the provisions of this Article shall not be construed as - (a) transferring to the President any powers vested by law in any person or authority other than the President; or (b) preventing Parliament from vesting any powers in any person or authority other than the President.
